mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals sustained monetary accommodation, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% in 75% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 65% of cases but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs in 55% of cases but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output, increasing input costs and corporate margin pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 in 60% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption growth (RSAFS above 12-month moving average) indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 12-month moving average in 70% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.3pp monthly) signals monetary policy tightening pressure, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 70% of cases but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market weakening, reducing household income and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE occurs in 50% of cases but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: High policy rates (FEDFUNDS above 2.0%) indicate restrictive monetary policy, increasing recession risk and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% in 65% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of those instances.
